C1.worst_defect: The hero lede under 'Point of sale for Vendure' is a 5-line centered paragraph ending on the one-line widow 'connection drops.'. On phone it grows to 6 lines, so the CTAs end up below a block of grey text before the eye reaches the till screenshot.

C2.worst_defect: The Refund row of the 'Live demo or your own store' table runs to 4 lines in the third column ('two Admin API calls...') against a bare 'Yes' in the second. The row gets visually heavy, though the content is honest.

C3.worst_defect: Step 8 of Quick start is an a–i lettered list for signing a till in, with no screenshot of the sign-in screen. Every other step is code or prose, so the one step that happens in the UI has no picture.

C4.worst_defect: In Step 4, each permission sits on its own bullet as a lone inline-code chip. That makes a long, sparse column that reads as padding instead of a compact list or table. On phone, paragraphs dense with chips (step 5, 'Left empty, it allows no origins unless APP_ENV is dev...') have uneven line spacing, because the chips push lines apart.

C5.worst_defect: The three figures on 'At the till' have no shared system. The payment screenshot is full width, with about 420 px of dead space in the cart column between the line items and the subtotal. The cashier sheet is a narrow ~420 px frame with the card nested inside a padded box (a double border). The closure figure is a ~546 px framed box with ~50 px of empty top padding and loose 'Counted / Expected / Exact' rows. On the home page, 'What it does today' also mixes two boxed cards (the right card ends 2 lines short, leaving a gap above its button) with 8 unboxed features below.

C6.worst_defect: In the phone payment screenshot the quick-amount row wraps, leaving '€50.00' alone on a second row under 'Exact €20.09 / €25.00 / €30.00'. That is the one ragged component on an otherwise clean 390 px set; there is no overflow anywhere.

C7.worst_defect: The share card (og-image, 1200x630) crops the till screenshot through the first product row. The price and 'In Stock' pills are sliced at the bottom edge and the cart panel is cut at 'Order discount', so the preview reads as clipped, not composed. Minor: 51 KiB of unused JS on '/'.

overall_worst.defect: The 'At the till' figures are framed inconsistently: a full-width payment screen with ~420 px of dead cart space, a ~420 px cashier sheet in a double-bordered padded box, and a ~546 px closure box with ~50 px of empty top padding. Three widths and three framing styles on one page.
overall_worst.fix: Crop each screenshot tight to its content (cut the empty cart column; drop the outer padded frame), render all three at one content width with the same 1 px border and radius as the home till image, and give each the same caption style.
